name: Lamb Leg
siboNotes: Plain lamb is protein-rich and FODMAP-free, making it excellent for SIBO diets. Avoid marinades containing garlic, onion, or high-FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Season with low-FODMAP herbs like rosemary, thyme, and oregano
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Roast with low-FODMAP vegetables like carrots and potatoes
Let rest 10-15 minutes after cooking for optimal tenderness
